fields.Name: T368 - Form Builder Center Pane Mode Switch
fields.Description: Exercises the fb-modeseg segmented control with three distinct render branches (mj-code-editor / mj-form-builder-canvas / mj-interactive-form preview) plus the CanvasDiverged disabled-Layout branch.

InputDefinition.goal: In Component Studio → Form Studio, click an existing form in the left 'Forms' rail to load it into the center pane. Locate the segmented view-mode control (Preview / Code / Layout). Click through the modes and verify the center pane content changes: 'Code' shows a code editor, 'Layout' shows the drag-and-drop canvas (sections/fields), and 'Preview' shows the live form render or a preview record strip. Note the 'Layout' tab may be disabled with a 'Custom code' chip explanation for hand-authored forms — that is a valid state, not an error. Pages can take 10-30s to load — wait, don't navigate away. Seeing the mode control switch the rendered content is success.

judgeValidationCriteria: Selecting a form and using the Preview/Code/Layout segmented control changes the center pane content accordingly
At least two of the three modes render distinct content (e.g. Code shows an editor, Layout shows a canvas or is intentionally disabled with a 'Custom code' explanation)
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
